{"description":"**Yggdrasil audit found IID hash inconsistency — now fixed in Python.**

## Algorithm (per spec/06-security.md)
```
IID = SHA-256(pubkey)[0:8] with U/L bit cleared
ygg_addr = [0x02] + SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7] + IID
```

## Fixed (this session)
- Python `crypto/identity.py:_pubkey_to_iid()` — uses SHA-256 ✓
- Python `ipv6/addr.py:pubkey_to_iid()` — uses SHA-256 ✓
- `test/vectors/yggdrasil-derivation.json` — regenerated with SHA-256 IID
- `test/vectors/node_address.json` — regenerated with SHA-256 IID
- `tests/crypto/test_identity.py` — vectors updated
- All 346 tests pass

## Still needs fixing (Rust)
- `rust/lichen-core/src/addr.rs:iid_from_pubkey_bytes` — currently uses SHA-512, should use SHA-256
- `rust/lichen-link/src/identity.rs:iid_from_pubkey_bytes` — currently uses SHA-256 ✓ (correct)

The lichen-core implementation is wrong; lichen-link is correct. Rust tests may be passing against incorrect vectors."}
